text:
Red Kiss ID@XBOX x IGN Showcase Trailer
From the publisher of Citizen Sleeper and The Pale Beyond and the developers of beloved historical fiction, Herald: The Interactive Period Drama... Experience a dark and supernatural take on dispatching narrative RPGs, set in the last days of the Cold War.

Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

Red Kiss is coming to XBOX Game Pass day one. Wishlist today!

Shrek 2 Remastered - ID@XBOX Showcase | Pre-Order Trailer
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered is now available for PRE-ORDER on XBOX Series X|S!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/shrek-2-remastered/9pcw6x6zqp4z

Get up to 10% OFF the PRE-ORDER now through November 9

The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics. 

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.
